about: The skills an agent may declare, each by its hash (the sha256 of its definition). Only what a LARRYD door really does today is here; a technology with no door in LARRYD has no skill yet.

skills.name: mTok charge
skills.door: LARRYD calls mTok /mtok/use after a DONE run
skills.does: charges the member's account the agent's own rate in mTok (0 = free); mTok alone decides, and a refused charge withholds the delivery
skills.agent: nothing to call: LARRYD applies it to every run of the agent

skills.name: LARRY LLM greeting
skills.door: LARRYD asks LARRY LLM for the member's greeting (GET /larry/greeting) before the RUN
skills.does: hands the agent the greeting LARRY LLM gives the member today, for every time of day, in the member's language
skills.agent: reads job["greeting"]: {"date", "lang", "greetings": {time of day: the words}}

skills.name: FROST identity
skills.door: LARRYD asks FROST who the agent works for on this RUN (GET /agents/identity) before the RUN
skills.does: hands the agent the member's first name, member type and account name, nothing else (no email, no address, no key)

skills.name: DA-M store
skills.door: LARRYD stores the files an agent's answer carries in the member's own DA-M (POST /dam/upload) after a DONE run
skills.does: keeps each file the answer carries in the member's DA-M, the agent's card key as its source; at most 10 files, all within the answer's own limit of 1 MB
